claims.statement: For every input law on the governed half-skew BSSC product channel P^{otimes 2}, let c_in=P(X_1X_2=11)-Pr[X_1=1]Pr[X_2=1] and C_out=I(Y_1;Y_2)+I(Z_1;Z_2). A paired-receiver binary-table curvature argument proves the unconditional inequality C_out >= 31 c_in^2/(20 ln 2). Canonical transaction 9bb22afe5abd3e1d9f419c1717bd61bb33a958ff supplies the necessary inequality C_out < 7/160 for any finite two-letter Marton law whose unnormalized value exceeds twice the optimal one-letter randomized-time-division value. Consequently every such gain forces |c_in| < sqrt(7 ln 2/248) < 7/50. This is a necessary condition only; it does not construct a Marton gain, rule one out, tensorize Marton's functional, or give a capacity converse.
